name: Arbitrate (Booth priority)
func: const booth=Number(flow.get('boothDemand')||0); const sla=Number(flow.get('slaDemand')||0); const fdm=Number(flow.get('fdmDemand')||0); let boothOut=booth, slaOut=sla, fdmOut=fdm; if(booth>0){ slaOut=Math.max(0,Math.floor(sla*0.7)); fdmOut=Math.max(0,Math.floor(fdm*0.7)); } let fanPct=Math.min(100,Math.max(boothOut,slaOut,fdmOut)); return [ {payload:slaOut}, {payload:fdmOut}, {payload:boothOut}, {payload:fanPct} ];
